paper_id: What does Transformer learn about source code_
title: What does Transformer learn about source code?
motivation: Transformer models process sequential code but may capture structural info (syntax tree, data flow). Existing NLP interpretability methods fail on programming languages' special structures.
problem_framing: How to extract structural information learned by transformer-based models? How to automatically construct program representation graphs without complex manual rules?
key_insight: Aggregating attention scores via max across heads reveals syntactic structure; different heads capture different semantic relations (provides natural edge types).
method_signature: Aggregated attention score (max over heads per layer) + Chu-Liu/Edmonds MST algorithm to extract semantic graphs from pre-trained CodeBERT/GraphCodeBERT.
evaluation_criteria: Tree distance distribution vs concrete syntax tree; edge type overlap with manual graphs; downstream VarMisuse task accuracy (Loc & Rep Acc).
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Self-attention handles implicit syntactic/data flow well but still limited to complex relationships like control flows; results slightly drop vs manual graphs.
evidence_for_taste: too dense to analyze, especially in deep layers
most information about linear word order
the final result drops slightly compared
